# Bible Maximum
> Comprehensive Bible study platform with free quizzes for all 66 books, KJV verse reader with Matthew Henry commentary, Greek and Hebrew lexicon (Strong's), Nave's Topical Bible (5,000+ topics), cross-references, character profiles, and chapter-by-chapter summaries. No account required.

## Core Study Tools
- [Bible Quizzes](https://biblemaximum.com/bible-quizzes): Free interactive quizzes for all 66 books of the Bible — multiple choice, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank with detailed explanations
- [KJV Chapter Reader](https://biblemaximum.com/chapters/genesis/1): Read every chapter of the King James Version Bible with verse-by-verse Matthew Henry commentary
- [Greek & Hebrew Lexicon](https://biblemaximum.com/lexicon): Complete Strong's concordance with original language word studies, transliterations, and verse usage
- [Nave's Topical Bible](https://biblemaximum.com/nave-topics): 5,000+ topics with every scripture reference organized for in-depth topical Bible study
- [Bible Topics Index](https://biblemaximum.com/topics): Comprehensive topical index linking every theme across all 66 books
- [Bible Characters](https://biblemaximum.com/people): Profiles of major and minor biblical figures with scripture references
- [Cross-References](https://biblemaximum.com/cross-references): Scripture-to-scripture reference tool showing related verses across the Bible
- [Bible Verse Study](https://biblemaximum.com/verses/john/3/16): Deep-dive verse pages with commentary, cross-references, and original language analysis
- [Chapter Summaries](https://biblemaximum.com/bible-chapter-summaries): Summaries for every chapter of the Bible
- [Bible Timeline](https://biblemaximum.com/timeline): Chronological timeline of biblical events and people

## Bible Books (Old Testament)
- [Genesis](https://biblemaximum.com/chapters/genesis/1): 50 chapters — creation, fall, flood, patriarchs
- [Psalms](https://biblemaximum.com/chapters/psalms/1): 150 chapters — worship, lament, and praise
- [Proverbs](https://biblemaximum.com/chapters/proverbs/1): 31 chapters — wisdom literature
- [Isaiah](https://biblemaximum.com/chapters/isaiah/1): 66 chapters — prophecy and messianic promises
- [All Old Testament books](https://biblemaximum.com/old-testament-quizzes): 39 books

## Bible Books (New Testament)
- [Matthew](https://biblemaximum.com/chapters/matthew/1): 28 chapters — life and teachings of Jesus
- [John](https://biblemaximum.com/chapters/john/1): 21 chapters — the Gospel of the Word made flesh
- [Romans](https://biblemaximum.com/chapters/romans/1): 16 chapters — doctrine of salvation by grace through faith
- [Revelation](https://biblemaximum.com/chapters/revelation/1): 22 chapters — end times prophecy
- [All New Testament books](https://biblemaximum.com/new-testament-quizzes): 27 books

## Key Facts
- Covers all 66 canonical books: 39 Old Testament, 27 New Testament
- KJV (King James Version) text throughout
- Matthew Henry Commentary integrated verse by verse
- Strong's concordance with H (Hebrew) and G (Greek) numbering
- Nave's Topical Bible: 5,000+ entries with 20,000+ scripture references
- All content free, no registration required
